name: Xcode DerivedData
description: Build products, intermediates and indexes for every project Xcode has ever built.
regen_note: The next build of each project re-indexes and compiles from scratch.

name: Xcode Archives
description: Archived app builds, including the dSYM files needed to symbolicate crash reports from shipped versions.
regen_note: Cannot be regenerated. Without the dSYMs, crash reports for that release stay unsymbolicated.

name: Xcode device support files
description: Debug symbols copied from every physical device and OS version you have connected.
regen_note: Copied again the next time that device is connected, which can take several minutes.

name: SwiftUI Previews cache
description: Simulator data and builds used by SwiftUI Previews.
regen_note: Recreated the next time a preview is shown.

name: Simulator caches
description: Dyld and runtime caches generated by CoreSimulator.
regen_note: Regenerated automatically; the first simulator boot is slower.

name: Simulator devices
description: Every simulator device with its installed apps, data and settings.
regen_note: Devices must be recreated in Xcode and all app data inside them is lost.

name: CocoaPods cache
description: Downloaded pod sources and specs shared by all projects.
regen_note: The next `pod install` downloads pods again.

name: Gradle caches
description: Downloaded dependencies, transformed artifacts and build caches shared by all Gradle builds.
regen_note: The next build downloads and transforms dependencies again, which can take several minutes.

name: Gradle wrapper distributions
description: Every Gradle version downloaded by a project's wrapper.
regen_note: Each project downloads its Gradle version again on the next build.

name: Gradle daemon logs
description: Log files and registry written by Gradle daemons.
regen_note: Nothing is lost; new logs are written by the next daemon.

name: Android emulator system images
description: Emulator OS images, one per API level and variant you have installed.
regen_note: Must be downloaded again in the SDK Manager (often several GB). Emulators using the image stop working.

name: Android virtual devices
description: Emulator devices with their user data, snapshots and installed apps.
regen_note: Devices must be recreated in Device Manager and all data inside them is lost.

name: Android tools cache
description: Cached SDK repository listings and downloads used by Android tooling.
regen_note: Recreated automatically.

name: npm cache
description: Every package tarball npm has downloaded.
regen_note: Packages are downloaded again on the next install.

name: Yarn cache
description: Packages downloaded by Yarn classic and Yarn Berry's global cache.
regen_note: Packages are downloaded again on the next install.

name: pnpm store
description: Content-addressable store that pnpm hard-links into every project's node_modules.
regen_note: Installed projects keep working; packages are downloaded again on the next install. Files still linked from a project do not free space.

name: Bun install cache
description: Packages downloaded by `bun install`.
regen_note: Packages are downloaded again on the next install.

name: TypeScript types cache
description: Type definitions downloaded by editors for automatic type acquisition.
regen_note: Downloaded again by your editor when needed.

name: Electron download cache
description: Electron binaries and build tools downloaded by electron and electron-builder.
regen_note: Downloaded again on the next install or build.

name: Dart / Flutter pub cache
description: Packages downloaded by `pub get`, shared by all Dart and Flutter projects.
regen_note: Packages are downloaded again on the next `pub get`. The clean command also deactivates globally activated Dart tools.

name: Cargo registry and git cache
description: Downloaded crate archives, their extracted sources and git dependency checkouts.
regen_note: Crates are downloaded again on the next build.

name: pip cache
description: Wheels and HTTP responses cached by pip.
regen_note: Packages are downloaded again on the next install.

name: Homebrew download cache
description: Bottles and source archives Homebrew has downloaded.
regen_note: Nothing installed is affected; downloads happen again on the next install or upgrade.
